_comment: Upstream design-pattern tracker for eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain (MIT). ERC adopts compatible patterns only (update existing pages instead of creating new ones, shared logbook, freshness and link health, retrieval evals). Autonomous note rewriting, scheduled self-editing agents and key-requiring research integrations are excluded because they conflict with ERC's read-only Tier 0, report-first wiki-lint, and the rule that constraints.md is never edited by the AI.
name: obsidian-second-brain
label: obsidian-second-brain
policy: design-pattern-only; autonomous rewriting, scheduled self-editing and keyed research integrations are excluded
last_audit_note: Initial baseline after a structural audit of commands/, hooks/, scripts/ and references/. Files were not read line by line. Coexistence rule: the user-level plugin may be installed beside ERC, and project skills take priority (see payload CLAUDE.template.md routing rule 5).

candidate_patterns.idea: One shared logbook so different agents know what each other did
candidate_patterns.status: already covered by log.md and run-ledger

capability_map.label: Ingest and update existing pages instead of piling up new ones
Vault health, freshness, link and contradiction checks
Shared log, decisions and session continuity
AI-first write rules, schema and frontmatter

explicitly_excluded.reason: Autonomous or scheduled self-editing conflicts with ERC's read-only Tier 0 and researcher-approved changes
Keyed or non-research integrations and marketing material
